method: Independent model second-author linguistic review of every one of the 81 unchanged proposed English renderings against its selected Spanish lexical definition, POS and context. An independent local scan also verified all 81 exact original decompressed raw-line SHA256 values, POS/sense indices, lexical glosses and usage inventories in the pinned archive, without copying media, quotations or examples. Approvals confirm original model English renderings of the chosen lexical sense, not English dictionary quotations, complete coverage, native-human/Mexican certification or universal modern usage. Existing source historical/regional/technical and construction restrictions remain part of each reading. No new inflection, alias, metaphorical or fixed-expression authority is granted. Changes to a held proposal require a new exact proposal/review.
